lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Good morning Daniel, thanks for joining. Today I want to cover the mobile app launch, the payment provider, testing, and our meeting schedule. Let's start with the launch. Where are we with the release?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Morning Maya. Honestly, we are behind. The payment flow is not finished, and we still have a login crash on Android that affects about five percent of users. I don't think we can ship on September 30th without cutting corners.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: How much more time do you need?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Two more weeks should be enough. If we move the launch to October 14th, the team can finish payments, fix the crash, and still run a proper beta.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Okay. Marketing will not love it, but a broken checkout would be worse. So we are agreed: the launch moves from September 30th to October 14th.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Agreed.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Next, payments. Last week we were debating whether to build our own payment system or use Stripe. What is your recommendation?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Use Stripe. Building in-house would take at least two months, and we would have to handle compliance ourselves. Stripe gives us cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay out of the box, and the fees are about the same as the alternatives we looked at.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That makes sense. Let's make it official: we will use Stripe for payments and drop the in-house option. Daniel, can you own the integration?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes. I will finish the Stripe payment integration by October 3rd, so there is time to test it in the beta.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Great. Now testing. How many people signed up for the beta?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: We have about 400 beta testers signed up so far, mostly from the waitlist. The problem is we don't have anyone dedicated to quality assurance. Our developers are testing their own features, and things slip through.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: What do you suggest?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Hire a contract QA tester for six weeks. That covers the beta and the first two weeks after launch. I checked the rates, and it should cost around $12,000.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That fits in the budget. We have about $20,000 left for this quarter. Let's do it: we will hire one contract QA tester for six weeks. Can you post the job listing?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Sure, I will post the QA contractor job listing by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Perfect. And the Android login crash, when will that be fixed?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: We found the cause. It is a token refresh bug in the authentication library. I will fix the login crash on Android before the beta build goes out on Monday.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Good. On my side, I will update the launch plan with the new date and send it to the marketing team by Friday. They need to move the press release and the app store campaign.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Could you also check with design? The checkout screens changed because of Stripe, and Priya has not reviewed them yet.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Good point. I will schedule a design review with Priya for next Tuesday, and I will invite you too.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Thanks. One open question: do we need a Spanish version of the app at launch? A lot of the beta testers asked for it.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I don't know yet. Let's not decide today. I will look at the waitlist data, and we can discuss it next week.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Sounds good.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Last item: our weekly status meeting. Monday mornings keep clashing with sprint planning. Can we move it?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Thursday works better for engineering. How about Thursdays at 10 AM?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Thursdays at 10 AM it is. Starting next week, the weekly status meeting moves to Thursday at 10 AM.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Let me recap. The launch moves to October 14th. We are using Stripe for payments. We are hiring a contract QA tester for six weeks. And the status meeting moves to Thursdays at 10 AM. Daniel, you have the Stripe integration by October 3rd, the QA job listing by Wednesday, and the Android login fix before Monday's beta build. I will send the launch plan to marketing by Friday and set up the design review with Priya on Tuesday. The Spanish version stays an open question.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That's everything on my list. Thanks, Maya.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Thanks, Daniel. Talk to you on Thursday.

s2s_clip.text: Good morning everyone. The launch moves to October 14th. Please send me the updated plan by Friday. Thank you for your hard work this week.
